subject: Updating file list after deleting a file

messages.author: a424a73546ce9bc7
messages.subject: Updating file list after deleting a file
parts:
Hi

I have the following in my ui.R

selectInput("filedelete", h4("File to delete:"),
            choices = c("none", unique(as.character(list.files(pattern = ".xlsx")))), 
            selectize = FALSE
)

and in my server.R

observe({  
    if (input$filedelete == "none") return()  
        file.remove(input$filedelete)
 })

With this, I can delete an excel file (which works fine). I also have code to upload a new file and to update the data I use for plotting (which works fine).
However, I haven't been able to update the list in the selectInput-Statement. When I delete a file, it still appears in the selectInput and if I upload a new file, it doesn't appear here.
I tried updateSelectinput just after the "file.remove(...)" line, but this didn't work. 
Could somebody help me to find a way to achieve this?

Cheers
Renger

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Updating file list after deleting a file
parts:
updateSelectInput is how you do it. If it's not working, we'll need to see what code you tried and whether there were any errors.

This is extremely dangerous code though. A malicious user could set literally any value for input$filedelete, just by popping open the JavaScript console and writing Shiny.onInputChange("filedelete", "C:\\AUTOEXEC.BAT") or whatever. At the very least you need to verify that the value of input$filedelete is a file they should actually be able to delete.

Also, you might consider adding an action button to perform the actual deletion, so they have to select a file and then explicitly hit a Delete button. You can do that with an observeEvent() instead of an observe().
